h1: Custom Insulated Apparel for Bulk Orders
metaDescription: Order custom insulated apparel for your team. Perfect for outdoor events, safety gear, and branded uniforms. Shop at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Insulated apparel keeps your team warm and your logo visible in cold conditions. From quilted vests like the Carhartt® Gilliam Vest to rugged jackets such as the Narvik Hybrid, these pieces combine thermal efficiency with professional branding. Ideal for safety managers equipping outdoor crews or HR directors choosing employee gifts that get used all winter.
